Hon'ble Mr. Justice Sandeep Sharma, Judge.
Whether approved for reporting?
1 For the Appellant(s): Mr. Balram Sharma, Deputy Solicitor General of India, in all the appeals.
For the Respondent(s): Mr. Ajay Sharma, Senior Advocate with Mr. Atharv Sharma, Advocate, for the private respondents.
Mr. Rajan Kahol, Mr. Vishal Panwar and Mr. B.C.Verma, Additional
Whether the reporters of the local papers may be allowed to see the judgment?
Advocate Generals with Mr. Rahul Thakur, and Mr. Ravi Chauhan, Deputy Advocate Generals, for the respondent-State.

_______________________________________________________ .
Sandeep Sharma, Judge(oral):
All the above captioned appeals are directed against the award dated 31.08.2011 passed by learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, District Una,
H.P. and the same are being taken up together for adjudication with the consent of learned counsel representing the parties.
2. By way of aforesaid appeals filed under Section 54 of the Land Acquisition Act,
1894 (hereinafter referred to as the Act), challenge has been laid to common award dated 31.08.2011, passed by learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court,

Una, in Reference Petition No.17/05 RBT 34/05/05, titled Khuda Baksh vs. LAC &
Others, alongwith other connected Land Reference petitions, as described in the award.

3. Undisputedly, the suit land belonging to the claimants, situate in Up-Mohal Kasba,
Mohal Basal, Tehsil and District Una, H.P., came to be acquired for public purpose;
namely; construction of "Nangal - Talwara Rail Line" and acquisition proceedings commenced with the issuance of Notification under Section 4 of the Act on 15.2.2001.
The Land Acquisition Collector (for short 'LAC') passed an award No.5, dated 14.09.2001 and awarded compensation of the acquired land as per the classification of the land mentioned in the award.
4.

Claimants, being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the amount of compensation awarded by 'LAC', preferred reference petition under Section 18 of the Act, before the learned Additional District Judge, Fast .
Track Court, Una, seeking therein enhancement of compensation, awarded by the Land Acquisition Collector.

entities.text:
Additional District Judge, Fast .
Track Court, Una
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, vide common award dated 31.08.2011, passed in above numbered reference petition alongwith other connected matters,
re-determined the market value of the acquired land @ Rs.75,000/- per Kanal irrespective of classification.

5. Appellant, being aggrieved and dissatisfied with the aforesaid award passed by the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, has approached this Court by way of above captioned appeals, seeking therein restoration of award passed by the learned Land Acquisition Collector after setting aside the judgment/award passed by the learned Additional District Judge,
Fast Track Court, Una.
6.

It is not in dispute before this Court that similar situate claimants, whose land also came to be acquired for construction of "Nangal - Talwara Rail Line" in the acquisition proceedings commenced with the publication of Notification issued under Section 4 of the Act, had filed land reference petitions before the learned Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una, praying therein to enhance the compensation awarded by 'LAC' in its award No.25, dated 4.12.2001.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, Fast Track Court, Una
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Those reference petitions were clubbed and disposed of by a common award dated 9.10.2009, wherein the Reference Court re-determined the market value of entire land irrespective of classification on uniform basis and awarded a sum of Rs.76,000/- per Kanal, which has been reaffirmed by this Court in RFA No.20 of 2010 titled as: General Manager,
Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & Others, .
decided on 20.09.2016 alongwith connected matters.

entities.text:
General Manager,
Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
7. Mr. Ajay Sharma, learned Senior Counsel duly assisted by Mr. Atharv Sharma, Advocate representing the respondents-claimants, while placing reliance upon the judgment passed in RFA General Manager vs Balak Ram & Others on 14 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/90452614/
2 No.20 of 2010 (supra), contended that these appeals also deserve to be dismissed, in terms of aforesaid judgment, because undisputedly claimants in the cases at hand alongwith the claimants in the aforesaid references/cases were awarded compensation vide a common award.

entities.text: RFA General Manager vs Balak Ram & Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: They further argued that since this Court had upheld the findings of Reference Court, returned in the aforesaid Reference Petitions, therefore, the claimants in the instant appeals are also entitled to market value of entire acquired land as done by Reference Court.

8. Mr. Balram Sharma, learned Deputy Solicitor General of India representing the appellant(s),
while fairly acknowledging the factum with regard to passing of judgment in RFA No.20 of 1010 (supra) was not able to refute the fact that claimants in the appeals at hand are also entitled to enhanced market value of acquired land, as has been held in the aforesaid Reference Petition, which was the basis for enhancing the compensation in the award under challenge in the appeals, and which has further been upheld by this Court in RFA No.20 of 2010(supra) alongwith other connected matters.

9. Consequently, in view of aforesaid discussion as well as fair stand adopted by Mr. Balram Sharma,
learned Deputy Solicitor General of India, representing the appellant(s), present appeals are dismissed and it is .
ordered that directions contained in RFA No.20 of 2010, titled as: General Manager, Northern Railway vs. Rajinder Kumar & Others, decided on 20th September, 2016 shall mutatis mutandis apply to the present cases also.

11. Interim order, if any, is vacated.
All the miscellaneous applications are disposed of.

(Sandeep Sharma), Judge June 14, 2023 (shankar)
